reviewed_scope: Manifest-selected readable library bundling; guard-dominance and conservative disabling, lexical/directive handling, standard line/file origin, frontmatter, include/path restrictions, main-template rejection, output protection,512KiB rejection and Fast macro side effects.
method: Read-only independent source review and temporary executable/CLI tests. No formal/shared edits or performance tests.

resolved_findings.failure: Alternate branch was not marked, so second guard body could execute originally but was removed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Treat elifdef/elifndef as alternate branches; preserve such guarded blocks.

resolved_findings.failure: Spliced undef was missed and spliced leading comment could release hidden directive when frontmatter moved; both executable counterexamples fail old version.
resolved_findings.resolution: Consistent C++23 whitespace splice processing with logical→physical offsets for directives/frontmatter/pragma detection; raw-splice cases rejected conservatively.

resolved_findings.failure: CAT(_Pra,gma) synthesized push_macro/pop_macro without literal _Pragma; restored undefined guard required second body. ## and %:%: cases both fail before fix.
resolved_findings.resolution: Any token-pasting in macro replacement disables all dedup conservatively.

resolved_findings.failure: Actual manifest temp.cpp containing main was selectable.
Actual Fast/Source builder origins were absent from protected destinations; read-only real-manifest assertion showed BinaryTrie origin unprotected.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate canonical/root-contained manifest origins and include them in protected output/report destinations.

guard_reasoning: A retained top-level #ifndef G with immediate unconditional empty #define G guarantees G defined on exit whether initially set or unset, provided observed mutations cannot invalidate it. Any visible matching undef, macro-stack operation/dynamic pragma, token-paste uncertainty or conflicting body conservatively disables removal; nested unknown conditions and alternate outer branches are preserved. Removed bodies must match exact source bytes; no minification or substitution of unequal blocks.
scope_limits: This is a bounded correctness review, not a full C++ preprocessor implementation or proof for adversarial external macro/header side effects. Trusted manifest-selected library inputs and declared supported headers remain the tool boundary.

Unknown dependencies and unsupported raw/physical-splice constructs are rejected rather than inferred. GNU/nonstandard location macros beyond requested standard __FILE__/__LINE__ were not claimed preserved.

Executable regressions target the identified bugs and requested line behavior; author separately owns41units/72PP/36runtime and output-byte bridges. Those totals are not relabeled as independent reviewer runs.
No C++ source library files, previous frozen audit artifacts or shared scripts were modified by reviewer.
